ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
a =result.match(/(\d+):(.+)\n/g).slice(0,10);
let x = [];
a.forEach(item =>{
item = item.match(/(\d+):(.+)\n/);	x.push(`https://api.dragonlongzhu.cn/api/novel_1.php?name=${java.get("key")}&n=${item[1]}`)
})
blist = java.ajaxAll(x).map(b=>b.body())

$=(b)=>JSON.parse(b);

Array.from(blist,(i)=>{
	u = $(i).download;
	list={
		name:$(i).title,
		author:$(i).author,
		kind:$(i).type,
		intro:$(i).js,
		cover:$(i).img,
		link:`data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(u)},{"type":""}`
		};
		return list
	});
</js>
ruleSearch.name: name
ruleSearch.author: author
